basis: The chart is a dual-axis plot with no visible y-axis metric names or numeric tick labels. The blue (2011) and red (2030) series are bound to separate vertical axes, and the 'Service' category has no printed data labels. Because the vertical scales are not defined or comparable, the visual position of the markers cannot be used to determine which year represents a higher cost. Therefore, the chart does not provide sufficient evidence to identify either year as higher cost, making the non-escalation alternative the only supported choice.
